content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fargo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's detailed eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training. Our synchronous online course delivers all 35 required contact hours over a structured schedule, allowing you to learn alongside other professionals while maintaining your current work commitments in Fargo's healthcare, technology, or financial-services sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute, including proof of your contact hours and work experience. Pay the associated PMI examination fee to activate your eligibility window and secure your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and strategy guidance, to reinforce course material. Schedule your proctored PMP exam when you feel ready, and sit for the assessment either online or at an authorized testing center near you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or published work in project management. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Fargo's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
